attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Northern Mariana Islands (CNMI) territory income tax calculation. Uses mirror code with tiered rebate system. Calculates tax using federal rates, then applies rebates: 90% if tax <= $20k, 70% on excess over $20k, 50% on excess over $100k. Bona fide residents file with CNMI Division of Revenue and Tax. Non-residents use Form 5074 per IRC 935.

initial_action.action_postfix: "NORTHERN MARIANA ISLANDS (CNMI) TERRITORY TAX - Mirror Code with Rebate" job.audit_trail swap addto " Tiered rebate system: 90%/70%/50%" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.mp_calculated_tax xdef 0.0 /result.mp_rebate_amount xdef 0.0 /result.mp_income_tax xdef

condition_details.condition_description: Meets bona fide residence test (183+ days, tax home, closer connection)
condition_details.condition_postfix: result.mp_days_present 183 >= result.mp_has_tax_home and result.mp_closer_connection and dup /result.mp_bona_fide_resident xdef

condition_details.condition_description: Qualifies for tier 2 rebate (70% on excess)
Qualifies for tier 3 rebate (50% on excess over $100k)

action_details.action_comment: Bona fide resident with tax > $100k - three-tier rebate
action_details.action_postfix:
true /result.mp_files_with_cnmi_dof xdef false /result.mp_files_with_irs xdef
result.federal_income_tax /result.mp_calculated_tax xdef
result.mp_rebate_tier_1_limit result.mp_rebate_tier_1_rate f* local@ tier1_rebate > result.mp_rebate_tier_2_limit result.mp_rebate_tier_1_limit f- result.mp_rebate_tier_2_rate f* local@ tier2_rebate > result.mp_calculated_tax result.mp_rebate_tier_2_limit f- result.mp_rebate_tier_3_rate f* local@ tier3_rebate > tier1_rebate tier2_rebate f+ tier3_rebate f+ /result.mp_rebate_amount xdef result.mp_calculated_tax result.mp_rebate_amount f- /result.mp_income_tax xdef
" Bona fide CNMI resident - files with CNMI Division of Revenue and Tax" job.audit_trail swap addto " Mirror code: uses federal tax rates (" result.filing_status strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Tax before rebate: $" result.mp_calculated_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Tier 1 rebate (90% on first $20k): $" tier1_rebate cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Tier 2 rebate (70% on $20k-$100k): $" tier2_rebate cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Tier 3 rebate (50% on excess over $100k): $" tier3_rebate cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Total rebate: -$" result.mp_rebate_amount cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Final CNMI tax: $" result.mp_income_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

policy_statement.policy_description: Calculate CNMI tax with tier 1 rebate (90% for tax <= $20k)
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Bona fide CNMI residents file with CNMI Division of Revenue and Tax per IRC 935. Mirror code uses federal rates. Tier 1 rebate: 90% if tax <= $20,000."

policy_statement.policy_description: Calculate CNMI tax with tier 2 rebate (70% on excess over $20k)
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Bona fide CNMI residents with tax $20k-$100k receive: 90% rebate on first $20k, 70% rebate on excess over $20k."

policy_statement.policy_description: Calculate CNMI tax with tier 3 rebate (50% on excess over $100k)
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Bona fide CNMI residents with tax > $100k receive: 90% rebate on first $20k, 70% on $20k-$100k, 50% on excess over $100k."
"Non-bona fide residents with CNMI-source income file Form 5074. Tax allocated proportionally. No rebate for non-residents. Must meet 183-day test for bona fide status."
